'''Tegist Byrg''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Glova]]. Supposedly leading a neutral planet, he was secretly working with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], so the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] conducted a [[Mission to Glova|mission]] to reveal his plot.

==Biography==
Byrg was born to a street beggar and quickly realized he didn't want to be poor. When he got older, he apprenticed himself to a local thief which lead Byrg to setting up his own fencing operation. Once established, he used his connections to get appointed governor of Glova.<ref name="PC" />

==Personality and traits==
He was greedy, power-hungry and unpleasant.<ref name="PC" />
